title: Reading Drill — A Map of Indoor Heat
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Map of Indoor Heat
passages.body:
**A** The tenants of a block of flats suspected that the top floor was always hottest. Volunteers used temperature loggers in living rooms and placed each device away from direct sunlight so that the readings could be compared.

**B** The indoor temperatures rose and fell at different times. On clear days a west-facing room remained warm late into the night, while a much smaller south-facing room cooled quickly once its windows were opened.

**C** The resulting chart identified two problems rather than one. The housing office prioritised shading for rooms with afternoon sun and checked whether ventilation could be improved in staircases and flats facing enclosed courtyards.
